skill.name: chatgpt-app-builder
skill.description: Guides agents through evaluating, designing, implementing, testing, deploying, and submitting ChatGPT Apps built with MCP and Apps SDK widgets.
skill.summary: Build ChatGPT Apps with MCP servers, interactive widgets, authentication guidance, testing workflows, and deployment templates.
skill.author: BayramAnnakov

security_audit.summary: All 400 static findings were adjudicated. The metadata address is blocked defensively, while other matches are documentation, template literals, configuration reads, or fixed asset paths. The deployable MCP template still needs authentication and restricted CORS before public use. Static review was capped at 400/457 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 57 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: MCP sessions and tool messages are accepted without authentication.
remediation.suggestion: Validate OAuth bearer tokens before session creation and every message. Bind each session to the authenticated user and reject missing or invalid tokens.

remediation.issue: The server sends wildcard CORS headers on MCP endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only approved ChatGPT and OpenAI origins in production. Permit wildcard origins only in an explicit local development mode.

remediation.issue: The production-ready workflow can deploy an incompletely hardened scaffold.
remediation.suggestion: Fail startup in production when authentication or origin allowlists are unset. Add integration tests for unauthorized and disallowed-origin requests.

content.value_statement: Building a ChatGPT App requires coordinated server, widget, security, testing, and submission work. This skill provides a phased workflow and reusable TypeScript templates.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates product fit with the Know, Do, and Show framework.
Creates app specifications with tools, widgets, authentication, and golden prompts.
Provides a Node.js MCP server scaffold with validated tool inputs.
Provides React widget patterns for state, actions, responsive layouts, and dark mode.
Guides local testing with MCP Inspector, ngrok, and golden prompts.
Covers OAuth planning, deployment configuration, and submission readiness.
limitations: Templates contain placeholders and mock items that require product-specific implementation.
The base server template does not enforce production authentication or restricted CORS.
Local testing requires Node.js 18+, npm, network access, and usually ngrok.
The skill does not host, submit, or operate the finished application automatically.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Product Fit
use_cases.description: Assess whether a product offers useful knowledge, actions, or visual experiences inside ChatGPT.

use_cases.title: Build an MCP Application
use_cases.description: Design tools and implement a TypeScript server with an interactive React widget.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Secure Release
use_cases.description: Review authentication, testing, deployment, and submission requirements before public launch.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Product
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate whether [product] should become a ChatGPT App. Assess Know, Do, and Show value, blockers, and three strong user prompts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a product idea and no existing specification.

prompt_templates.title: Design the App Specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an app specification for [product]. Define two to five tools, widget needs, authentication, data boundaries, and golden prompts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn a suitable product idea into an implementation plan.

prompt_templates.title: Implement the Application
prompt_templates.prompt: Build the ChatGPT App from [specification]. Customize the MCP server and React widget, validate inputs, add tests, and document required configuration.
prompt_templates.scenario: Generate a working project from an approved specification.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [project] for production. Verify OAuth, authorization, CORS, security headers, rate limits, idempotency, responsive widgets, deployment, and submission requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Perform an advanced release review before public deployment.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a task-management product for ChatGPT.
output: Fit: strong for user-specific task knowledge and task creation.
Primary tools: list tasks, create task, and complete task.
Main blocker: user data and write actions require authentication.

output_examples.input: Design a widget for viewing and completing tasks.
output: Use a compact responsive list with status and priority.
Expose completion as an explicit action with feedback.
Keep full records in widget metadata and concise summaries in model content.
Require OAuth for user-specific reads and every mutation.
Restrict production origins and set security headers.
Run tool, widget, golden-prompt, mobile, and failure-path tests.

best_practices: Complete the fit evaluation and app specification before generating code.
Validate every tool input and require authentication for user data or write operations.
Test tools, widgets, discovery prompts, mobile layouts, and failure paths before submission.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy the placeholder server without authentication and origin restrictions.
Do not place sensitive records in model-visible content when widget metadata is sufficient.
Do not expose broad tools with overlapping descriptions or unbounded inputs.

faq.question: What does this skill build?
faq.answer: It guides creation of ChatGPT Apps with MCP tools, Node.js servers, React widgets, testing, deployment, and submission preparation.

faq.question: Does it include working templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes server, widget, test, and deployment templates that require product-specific customization.

faq.question: Is authentication included?
faq.answer: OAuth guidance is included, but the base server template does not enforce authentication. Add token validation before production use.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What local software is required?
faq.answer: Use Node.js 18 or newer and npm. Network testing usually uses MCP Inspector and ngrok.

faq.question: Does the skill submit the app automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prepares the project and submission checklist, but a verified organization must complete review and publication.
